context: Client A/B: dark band above the female brief appears on gate3 HIGH and LEAN, and persists with creature shadows and SSAO off; it sits on the pelvis skin1/skin2 nodes, which have their own PLTs (pfh0_pelviss1/2). Evidence: output/phenotypes/poly-budget-lean-ingame-v1/client-review-v2.
userMessage: each part model should have it's entire texture self contained in a single PLT files named the same as the model filename

directions.textureRule: One PLT per part model, named exactly like the model file; all nodes of that model (including skin1/skin2 overlay shells and garment/brief/bra regions) sample that single PLT.
directions.appliesTo: All body part models (female and male, LEAN build first, then the production pipeline).

interpretationToConfirm: Garment colour (brief/bra) moves into PLT layers of the part PLT, the stock NWN convention; normal/roughness maps stay one per model (<model>n.tga / <model>r.tga).
